faq.title: A few things you might be wondering.

items.a: Here, it means original games that combine gameplay ideas from two inspirations. The phrase is also used for AI-assisted desktop crossover mods and for merging puzzles. This site focuses on original, playable browser games.

items.q: Can I merge the actual Minecraft and Elden Ring files?
items.a: Our browser tool does not combine commercial game files. It will generate an original 2D game inspired by selected mechanics. Desktop mashup tools and mods follow a different process and may require games you own.

items.q: Is the AI generator available now?
items.a: Not yet. You can play our three handcrafted examples today. Real generation will open after the model connection and end-to-end checks are complete.

items.q: Does it cost anything to play?
items.a: The premade examples are free and need no account. We plan to offer two trial generations and optional credit packs when generation launches. Prices and purchases are not available yet.

items.q: Do the examples work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Use the touch controls below the game. A recent browser with Canvas worker support is required. Keyboard controls are available on desktop.
